obligations.match: These are fixed-score sensitivity bands, not population confidence intervals.
Four VCC spoof strata contain only 4/4/4/6 speakers, so no 21DF separation result transfers to new speakers or attacks.
The bands and reweighting results describe fixed scores under declared procedures, not population confidence or safety.
We claim neither cell-level agreement with Fig.~4(c) of the ASVspoof 2021 report nor population confidence.
Two deterministic systems on a fixed trial list have no sampling uncertainty until a perturbation law is declared.
A distinct-score-boundary recomputation changes no displayed value by 0.001 point.
For ordered pair $(A,B)$, $\Delta\mathrm{EER}_{A,B}=100(\mathrm{EER}_A-\mathrm{EER}_B)$ percentage points (negative favors $A$); every replicate refits both thresholds.
A pair is \emph{separated under procedure $h$} when its simultaneous band excludes zero; write this indicator as $I_{p,h}$.
The identified object is the change in $\Delta\mathrm{EER}$ and $I_{p,h}$ on the fixed scores, not population uncertainty.
Because a population sampling law is not identified for 21DF, we call these procedure-sensitivity bands, not confidence intervals.
The cited derivation assumes thresholds fixed outside the test set, so these are reconstructions of its adaptation to EER rather than exact finite-sample tests.
Their $3\times4$ crossing gives 12 positive, class-normalized rules fixed without inspecting scores.
A constrained PW bootstrap that exactly restores each of the three bona-fide source masses and five spoof-stratum masses also separates 18/28 and 0/6.
This constrained arm was designed after an earlier arm failed; it is a robustness check, not prospective evidence.
Thus neither threshold handling nor movement of these eight class-specific masses is necessary for the contrast.

This check is intentionally EER-only because it transfers the paper's $\Delta$EER comparison; ASVspoof~5's primary Track~1 metric is minDCF.
It is not a system-performance replication or population claim.
This simulation evaluates procedures under those imposed models; it does not establish that either model describes 21DF.
The legacy SSL-AASIST/AASIST files lack their originating run logs.
Benchmark reports should publish trial-to-speaker/attack membership and source weights, not only trial counts.
A band containing zero means the procedure does not separate that pair; it does not establish equality.
We make no population, rank-confidence or formal Arena-inference claim.
Across these rules, source deletions and searched directions, separation between the four SSL detectors and four organizer baselines is stable; within-cohort ranking is not.
Population confidence requires independently sampled units and a defensible acquisition law.
